caption:
Humility: how the servants of the Most Compassionate walk and speak.

This verse describes the servants of Ar-Rahman as those who walk on the earth humbly, and who answer the ignorant only with words of peace. This evening, think back on a moment today when a calm reply would have been enough.

Surah Al-Furqaan 25:63

Save this for the next time someone tries to pull you into an argument.

#humility #ibadurrahman #surahfurqan #calmheart
